summary: Iteration 116 backend+frontend test of Activity Trail PDF export and Universal Activity expansion. Backend export endpoint (JSON+PDF) works for member, user, guest, customer (where the id exists in customer_accounts). Frontend Member dialog (member-tab-activity), UserEditDialog (user-tab-activity) and ProductsPage customer profile all render ActivityFeed with PDF + JSON buttons; downloads succeed and return application/pdf / application/json with HTTP 200. One real bug found: ProductsPage customer dialog also opens for sales-aggregator-only customers whose id is NOT in customer_accounts -- /api/activity/customer/{id}/export returns 404 and the UI shows an 'Uncaught runtime error' overlay (Script error.) instead of a clean toast. Smoke + iter115 regressions still 31/31 passing.

minor.issue: Inconsistency vs /api/activity/customer/{id}: the read endpoint returns 200 with an empty/aggregated list for any id (because it scans sales by customer_id), but /export 404s when id is not in customer_accounts. The aggregator at /api/customers includes synthetic cust_<hash> ids (TEST_SaleTotals_e973257e, walk-ins, etc.) that have sales but no customer_accounts record, so the UI exposes those ids to ActivityFeed and the PDF/JSON export 404s. Recommend: in export_subject_profile, when subject_kind=='customer' and the customer_accounts doc is missing, fall back to a minimal profile built from db.sales {customer_id: id} aggregation (name, phone, total_spent, last_visit) so the PDF export matches the customers tab semantics. Alternatively only render ActivityFeed in ProductsPage when the customer.id starts with the same prefix used by customer_accounts.

ui_bugs.issue: When the customer-dialog activity export 404s (synthetic cust_xxx id not in customer_accounts), an 'Uncaught runtime errors: Script error.' react-error-overlay appears (bundle.js:144601). The try/catch in downloadProfile catches the axios error but a Blob-typed error.response.data (because responseType:'blob') is not the JSON detail expected; the toast still fires ('Export failed') but a secondary unhandled promise rejection (or sync throw) triggers the overlay. Recommend: in downloadProfile, when response is non-OK and responseType is blob, attempt blob.text()->JSON.parse to extract the detail; always return cleanly. Also wrap a.click()/URL.createObjectURL in its own try; do not throw past the catch.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routers/activity.py — `export_subject_profile` enforces 404 for customer when customer_accounts row missing, while the sibling read endpoint silently aggregates from sales. Inconsistent contract.

/app/frontend/src/components/ActivityFeed.jsx (downloadProfile) — when `responseType:'blob'`, axios wraps the 404 JSON in a Blob; `e.response?.data?.detail` will always be undefined and a secondary error can escape. Suggest a `if (!r || r.status >= 400) { ... }` style guard plus blob->text decode.

/app/frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.jsx (~line 1690) — the gate `customerProfile.id` is true for sales-aggregator-synthetic ids that have no customer_accounts row; the gate should additionally require the id to actually belong to customer_accounts, or accept that PDF/JSON downloads may 404 and handle it.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend export endpoint is solid for member/child/user/guest and for customers WHO EXIST IN customer_accounts. The customers tab on /sales also lists synthetic aggregator rows (cust_<hash> ids built from sales) which lack a customer_accounts doc; export 404s for these and the React error overlay shows up. New frontend testids verified: member-tab-activity, user-tab-activity, activity-download-pdf-btn, activity-download-json-btn (and unchanged activity-note-input/activity-note-submit/activity-file-input). The PDF body extraction in the test uses pdfminer (already installed) to validate 'Activity Trail' + subject name appear in rendered text.
rca of the issue: ProductsPage's Customers tab is fed by a sales-aggregator endpoint that returns one row per distinct customer_id found in sales (including walk-ins / TEST_ rows). The ActivityFeed component is rendered as long as customerProfile.id is truthy. The read endpoint /api/activity/customer/{id} also scans sales by customer_id and returns a list, so it succeeds. However /api/activity/customer/{id}/export specifically does `db.customer_accounts.find_one({id: id})` and 404s if absent. Because the dialog rendered the feed, the user can click PDF/JSON → 404 → axios throws with responseType=blob → e.response.data is a Blob (not the JSON detail). The catch fires toast.error('Export failed') but the error-overlay is also triggered for an uncaught rejection (likely a secondary throw on the URL.createObjectURL/a.click path or a duplicate handler). Fix: align contracts (export should fall back to sales-aggregator profile or the dialog should hide the feed when not in customer_accounts) and make ActivityFeed.downloadProfile fully tolerant of blob-typed error responses.
